title.official: Terms of reference and modalities for the establishment and functioning of the Independent International Scientific Panel on Artificial Intelligence and the Global Dialogue on Artificial Intelligence Governance
title.short: UNGA resolution 79/325 on the AI Scientific Panel and Global Dialogue

relevance.reason: Establishes the terms of reference and modalities for the Independent International Scientific Panel on Artificial Intelligence and the Global Dialogue on Artificial Intelligence Governance, the principal universal AI-governance follow-up to the Global Digital Compact. It is an institutional, non-binding resolution limited to the non-military domain.
ai_provisions: Operative paragraph 1 — establishes the Independent International Scientific Panel on AI
Operative paragraphs on the Global Dialogue on AI Governance — mandate, participation and modalities
Preamble — recalls the Pact for the Future and the Global Digital Compact; limits the Panel and Dialogue to the non-military domain
relevance.excluded_scope: Non-military domain only; does not create legal obligations or a treaty body with binding decision-making power.

dates.notes: Adopted without reference to a Main Committee (A/79/L.118); document distributed 27 August 2025.

status_note: Adopted. Institutional follow-up under the General Assembly; non-binding.

languages.note: UN official languages; only English acquired.

sources.note: Official A/RES/79/325 English PDF, 4 pages; downloaded and stored.

checks.check: Title, resolution number and adoption date checked on the document.
checks.result: A/RES/79/325; adopted 26 August 2025; title as recorded.

checks.result: The resolution and the activities of the Panel and Dialogue are limited to the non-military domain and do not refer to AI for military purposes.

verification.notes: Full text preserved. The Panel and Dialogue are institutional mechanisms, not a treaty or a standard-setting body with binding outputs.

related.note: Implements the decision in the Global Digital Compact, annexed to the Pact for the Future (A/RES/79/1), to establish the Panel and initiate the Dialogue.
Earlier UNGA AI resolution recalled in the preamble.

text.extraction_note: Text extracted from the official English PDF with pypdf; paragraph anchors refer to file pages.

gaps: Non-binding: the Panel and Dialogue produce scientific and deliberative outputs, not legal obligations.
The mandate expressly excludes military AI, so it does not fill the military-AI governance gap.
Appointment of Panel members, rules of procedure and work programme are not covered by the resolution and were not verified.
Only the English version is stored.
